name: Classroom Teacher
description: Full-time generalist teacher toolkit — plan lessons and units, build assessments and rubrics, differentiate for mixed-readiness classes, run inquiry/project units, and draft parent- and report-facing communications in your own voice.

name: Relief / Casual Teacher
description: Toolkit for casual and relief teachers covering an unfamiliar class — build or adapt a day pack, put together a lesson and student task sheet on short notice, check a plan for support needs, and run a quick end-of-lesson check.

name: Learning Support Teacher
description: Toolkit for learning support, inclusion, and EAL/D specialists — generate and audit differentiation options, adapt task sheets and checks for individual students, and draft report comments and family communications for a support caseload.

name: Curriculum Coordinator
description: Toolkit for curriculum coordinators, heads of department, and instructional designers — map scope and sequence, design inquiry and project units, build assessment schedules and rubrics for cross-marker consistency, catalogue resources for a repository or LMS, and explain curriculum to families.

name: School Leader
description: Toolkit for principals, deputies, and school administrators — draft whole-school and community communications in a consistent voice, explain curriculum changes to families, and keep an eye on the school's assessment calendar.
